description:
Manage thread files under the vault's threads directory.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list thread files, open only by default
  show THREAD [--json] — show a single thread file
  new [--name NAME] [--kind KIND] [--category CATEGORY] [--currency ISO] [--rate RATE] — create a thread file
  delete THREAD [-y] — permanently delete a thread file

Flags:
  list: QUERY is an optional fuzzy search ranked by similarity; --all includes paused and closed threads; --json emits JSON.
  show: THREAD is a thread name or 'Kind/Name'; --json emits JSON.
  new: --name thread name; --kind one of project, process, topic; --category one of professional, personal, voluntary; --currency 3-letter ISO code, the default currency for `hours`; --rate default hourly rate, requires --currency.
  delete: -y skips the confirmation prompt.

Examples:
  ["list", "--json"]
  ["show", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "SGB", "--kind", "project", "--category", "professional", "--currency", "ZAR", "--rate", "2500"]
  ["delete", "Topics/Old", "-y"]

Notes:
  `new` prompts on stdin for any of --name, --kind and --category not supplied; always pass all three.
  `delete` prompts for confirmation unless -y is given, and permanently removes the file.
  Threads must exist before `hours log`, `payments log`, `buffer add-*` or `tasks add` can reference them.

BLOCKED: delete. These subcommands are refused and calling one returns an error. Do not attempt them.
